data.exact_reserve_text: The Agency has seen continued favourable development on the RITC contracts written by the Syndicate. This is borne out by the reviews performed by the Actuarial Function as at 30th June 2015, 30th September 2015 and 31st December 2015. The result, as detailed above, is driven by a general trend of reductions in incurred claims due to favourable settlement of claims, including releases chiefly from Construction Defect contracts. Gross technical provisions have reduced to GBP 87.8m from GBP 96.6m, driven by reductions on the legacy business which is partly offset by the increased IBNR on the live business.
data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims reserves were GBP 96.644m at 1 January 2015. Management reports continued favourable development on legacy/RITC contracts, driven by favourable settlements and releases chiefly from construction defect contracts, resulting in a reduction in gross technical provisions to GBP 87.761m at year end. The report does not provide an explicit aggregate GROSS prioryear movement figure for PYD; the claims development table is limited and contains an aggregate "Before 2011" column that prevents a full diagonal PYD calculation, so a quantified gross prior year movement cannot be determined from the disclosures.
raw_causal_phrases: continued favourable development on the RITC contracts written by the Syndicate
reductions in incurred claims due to favourable settlement of claims, including releases chiefly from Construction Defect contracts
driven by reductions on the legacy business which is partly offset by the increased IBNR on the live business

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: A clear GROSS prioryear development (GBP ) is not explicitly disclosed. The Income Statement line 'Claims incurred in prior underwriting year' is a P&L amount and is NOT the prioryear reserve movement per instructions, so it was not used. The claims development triangle is provided but contains an aggregate 'Before 2011' column (excluded by rules) and limited development diagonals, preventing reliable calculation of total gross PYD. Therefore prior_year_development_gbp_m is left null. Opening gross claims outstanding was taken from the Statement of Financial Position (96,644 GBP 000) - high confidence. Premium mix taken from Segmental Analysis (note 2).
